title: Best Vhs Tv (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selected products from CNET, Pocket‑Lint, and Yahoo Tech that were explicitly recommended. RetroBox appears in two sources, so it is ranked first. GoVideo VR2940 appears in one source and is ranked second.
assumptions: Prices are only shown when a source lists them; no other price information is used.

verdict.line: Picture a family gathering where everyone wants to watch old home movies on a modern screen. RetroBox lets you play VHS tapes on an LCD that looks like a CRT, so it works with any TV and keeps the nostalgic feel. The catch: it costs $399 for early birds and has no built‑in VCR Plus guide.
